production.prompt: Create ONE production sprite sheet, wide 2:1 canvas, exactly four EQUAL columns and TWO EQUAL rows, eight unique full-body frames left-to-right, top then bottom. TRUE transparent RGBA (actual zero alpha gutters), NO checkerboard drawn, white surface, color backdrop, text, numbers, outline, shadows or effects. Big clear margins on ALL edges of each cell, ensure no limb or tail crosses any boundary. Same camera elevation, lighting and anatomy across all cells. Painted 2.5D tabletop art. Exact same bald blue-grey ghoul with long pointed ears, pink tongue, ivory eyes, long clawed arms and bare feet, beige wrapped forearms and calves and ragged tan loincloth. No accessories. Subject faces lower right, frontal three-quarter matching the front gameplay reference. Single planted-foot pivot. Start facing slightly left of straight DOWN toward viewer and end facing down-right three quarter. Do not cover a half-circle. Read body rotation from lead foot, then hips and shoulders, with open hands near the hip. Show eight stages, shift leg once and finish feet planted. Same body scale.
